title: Younger sister and the hall on Robertson
summary: Talk about Arthur's younger sister who ran a hall where recordings were made, and whether she would know about their father.

story.theme_name: Starting the tape: names, dates and places

blocks.x: Well, I was going to ask you how to think of it. Your sister, I guess I met her over at the hall there on Robertson. Yeah.
